title: Settings
knowledge.facts.subject: Fact subject pattern
knowledge.archive.skipTypes: Scene types left out of the index
intro: Keys, the install's settings and each persona's. A value set in the environment wins over what is saved here.
app.intro: Saved in settings.yaml in the data home, for every persona.
persona.intro: Saved in this persona's persona.yaml in your data home. A persona that ships with Eidolon is copied there on the first save; the original stays untouched.
warnings: The settings files have {count} problem(s) Eidolon ignores
restart.title: Restart to apply saved settings
restart.body: Some saved settings are read only when Eidolon starts or when memory first runs. Restarting interrupts running jobs, and can't happen during a call.
restart.mcpTitle: The MCP server still serves the old settings
restart.mcpBody: Calls already use what you saved; only the MCP server keeps what it read at start until a restart.
restart.timeout: Eidolon didn't come back. Start it again from the terminal.
restart.confirm.title: Restart and interrupt running jobs?
restart.confirm.body: Restarting interrupts these jobs. What they finished is kept, and you can resume each from its page once Eidolon is back.
restart.confirm.unknown: Eidolon couldn't list its jobs. A restart interrupts any that still run; you can resume each from its page once Eidolon is back.
restart.confirm.ephemeral: Link checks and plans don't resume: run them again afterwards.
form.envOverride: {env} is set in the environment, which wins over this file. Change it there.
form.readOnly: Shown only: set it in settings.yaml or with {env}.
form.savedRestart: Saved. Restart Eidolon to apply it.
form.reindex.title: Change the embedding model?
form.reindex.body: Every persona's knowledge index needs to be built again, and memory needs a new Qdrant collection: memories kept so far are lost.
form.invalid.comma: A path can't contain a comma.
form.invalid.relative: Use a path relative to the persona's folder that stays inside it.
form.invalid.timezone: Use a time zone name such as Asia/Shanghai.
form.invalid.language: Use a two-letter language code such as zh, or none.
form.invalid.voice: A Fish Audio voice id is 32 characters of 0-9 and a-f.
help.local.viewerName: What she calls you in calls. Leave it empty and she uses no name.
help.memory.qdrant.host: Memory is on while this is set. Use 127.0.0.1 for the Docker container setup shows.
help.embeddings.model: Changing it means building every persona's knowledge index again.
help.embeddings.dim: Changing it means building every persona's index again and a new memory collection.
help.sources.cookiesFromBrowser: The browser whose cookies yt-dlp uses for videos behind a login. Reading them may ask for your Keychain password.
help.sources.cookiesFile: A cookies.txt for yt-dlp, which writes the merged cookies back into it.
help.sources.ytDlp: Eidolon installs and updates its own yt-dlp unless this is set.
help.voice.model: drama-3 performs the prompt's delivery cues. s2.1-pro-free costs nothing but may read the cues aloud.
help.voice.voiceId: The Fish Audio voice she speaks with.
help.knowledge.gate.enabled: Skips the knowledge search on turns that don't ask about her.
help.knowledge.facts.files: Name patterns for the files in her facts folder, comma-separated. Default *.txt.
help.transcription.language: The language of her videos as a two-letter code, or none. Default zh.
help.prompt: Relative to her folder. Default prompt.md.
help.selfie.references: One per line, relative to her folder.
help.identity.timezone: Her clock, for the date and time she knows.
help.memory.agentId: Empty keeps each persona's memories of you apart, under her own id.
help.selfie.quality: Higher costs more and takes longer while you wait in the call.
credentials.intro: Keys are saved in credentials.json in the data home, readable only by you, and never shown again.
credentials.optionalBody: Without these, embeddings, reranking and transcript refinement go through your OpenRouter key. Set the matching API base under General.
credentials.replace: Saved. Type a new key to replace it.
credentials.envOverride: {env} is set in the environment, which wins over a key saved here.
credentials.SONIOX_API_KEY.note: Speech to text. Needs credit on the account; calls and transcription bill per minute of audio.
credentials.OPENROUTER_API_KEY.note: Her mind, memory, selfies and embeddings. Needs prepaid credit.
credentials.FISH_API_KEY.note: Her voice. Needs API credit, which is separate from a fish.audio membership; new accounts start at $0.
check.missing: Nothing to check: no key is saved.
check.management-key: This is a management key, which can't run models. Create a regular API key.
check.no-credit: The account has no credit left.
check.forbidden: The key isn't allowed to do this. Check its permissions and budget.
check.not-found: The provider couldn't find what the check asked for.
check.rate-limited: The provider is busy. Try again in a minute.
check.unexpected: The provider sent an answer the check doesn't recognize.
check.not-qdrant: Something answers there, but it isn't Qdrant.
check.needs-api-key: This Qdrant wants an API key, which Eidolon doesn't support.
check.starting: Qdrant is still starting. Try again in a few seconds.
check.soniox.invalid-key: Soniox rejected this key. A key from an EU, Japan or India project doesn't work either: Eidolon supports US projects only.
check.qdrant.unreachable: Nothing answers there. Is the container running?
check.envOverride: This checked the key from the environment, which wins over the one saved here.
check.warning.cannot-list-models: The key works but can't list models. Make sure it may use real-time and async transcription and upload files.
check.warning.unknown-model: The provider doesn't list the model in your settings.
check.warning.deprecated-model: The voice model s1 retires on 2026-12-31. Switch to drama-3.
check.warning.free-tier: This OpenRouter account never bought credits, so paid models will fail.
check.warning.key-limit-reached: The key's own spending limit is used up.
check.warning.budget-exhausted: A budget this key falls under is used up.
check.warning.no-credit: No API credit, and the voice model is a paid one. Add credit on fish.audio.
check.warning.voice-unknown: Fish doesn't know this persona's voice. Pick another.
check.warning.voice-private: This persona's voice belongs to another account. Pick a public one.
check.warning.cannot-verify: This provider offers nothing to check a key against, so it wasn't verified.
check.warning.version-mismatch: This Qdrant's version is more than one minor release away from the one Eidolon is built for.
